Images 2 and 3 are visual-quality references only for disciplined warm-ivory editorial layout, ballistic meters, walnut, black, and steel; do not copy their logo, brand, wording, or exact layout.

Meters visibly correspond to the machine layers via thin leader lines. A slim next-section reveal at the bottom proves this is a full web page.

Color palette: warm ivory, ink black, charcoal steel, brushed stainless, dark walnut accents, small VEEMAP orange and green signals.

ONE PERFORMANCE."; "We combine world-class automation assets with in-house R&D to build machines engineered for speed, accuracy and uptime."; "TELL US ABOUT YOUR PROCESS"; "AI VISION"; "HIGH-SPEED MOTION"; "INDUSTRY 4.0 HMI"; "PREDICTIVE HEALTH"; "236 PROJECTS DELIVERED".
